narr: A cold front passed through the area, triggering showers and thunderstorms. Moderate amounts of instability combined with a slow storm motion caused a couple storms to produce flooding and flash flooding.
ev: A roadway and sidewalks were covered with moving water at the intersection of Valley Street and Main Street.
lsr: ROADWAY AND SIDEWALKS COVERED WITH MOVING WATER AT THE INTERSECTION OF VALLEY STREET AND MAIN STREET.
